verdict.rationale: HelixDB has no documented natural-language command interface of its own. The evidence shows an official MCP endpoint whose tools take exact JSON requests (e.g. helix_execute_read_query) and a `helix chef` bootstrapper that installs query skills and a docs MCP for an external agent. That evidence belongs to the MCP-server and agent-setup stories. Here it is only a building block: the user's own agent would have to turn natural language into structured operations, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
